entry_contracts.native_ability: Normal native action-specific resources, charges, statuses, equipment, targets, range, LOS and recasts apply.
entry_contracts.native_ws_tp: At least1000TP. CWeaponSkillState spends actual TP using normal Sekkanoki/Meikyo Shisui/conserve rules. No mob-formula substitution.
entry_contracts.native_ws_target: Native self-target classification or legal hostile, with native range, LOS and claim rules.
entry_contracts.ordinary_or_quest_ws: Approved ordinary permanent/quest learning; selected merit unlock still required. Current weapon admission is separate.
entry_contracts.equipment_or_signature_ws: No grant from zero job bytes. Each equipment/signature exception requires its own confirmed source and conditions.
entry_contracts.highest_native_trait: Highest eligible native rank per family/modifier, selected merits only; no duplicate full main/support stack.
entry_contracts.native_rank99_skill: Highest native assigned-job rank at99, native multiplier and earned native AEP additions preserved. No added general skill merits, gift-stat package or ML.
entry_contracts.inactive_policy_pending: No accepted autonomous rule or implementation. Preserve IrohaII hybrid identity; full catalog does not mean indiscriminate casting.
